description: A short-lived, server-owned learning workspace binding. It is not a reusable chat conversation.
invariants: userId is derived from the authenticated request, never from a browser payload
question-bound assistance is rejected when questionId differs from the server-authoritative current question
a context never appears in the independent subject Q&A conversation list
conversationId and agentConversationId are never accepted as context aliases
superseded and expired contexts reject writes with workspace_stale
